description: c3845 connectivity/server-pillar END-TO-END loopback match regression. Extends listen_host_peer_smoke (join handshake only) to the FULL match lifecycle on 127.0.0.1: start -> spawn(both players) -> play -> score -> end -> endscreen. Two PerfectDark.exe in one clean install: a listen-host (--host + --listen-bind 27200, writes pd-host.log) that seeds a Combat Sim on base:arena_mp_felicity via --launch-mp-room and auto-starts the match via --host-autostart once the remote client reaches CLSTATE_LOBBY plus a ~2s settle; and a client (--connect-host 127.0.0.1:27200, writes pd-client.log) that joins and auto-follows the host's SVC_STAGE_START (it sends CLC_STAGE_READY automatically on receipt, and answers the manifest handshake READY, so the ready gate fires its 3s countdown rather than the 30s timeout -- no --auto-ready flag needed). The match runs with --match-timelimit-sec 35 (a test-only seconds-granularity override of g_MpTimeLimit60 at the lv.c time-limit gate; the wire timelimit is minutes-only), so it ends deterministically in ~35s; the host's time-limit path fires mainEndStage -> mpEndMatch (endscreen) and broadcasts SVC_STAGE_END so the client also ends and shows its endscreen. The host auto-start fires the SAME high-level lobby-leader path the Room 'Start Match' button uses (netLobbyRequestStartWithSims), so room-assign / manifest-broadcast / participant-playernum / ready-gate setup all run -- no fragile Room-UI navigation (which crashes in deeper sub-screens; see mp_room_flow.json). Assertions run against the concatenation of pd-host.log and pd-client.log: the join lines (as in the peer smoke) PLUS 8 MATCH: milestones, with player-spawn appearing for BOTH slot=0 (host's player 0) and slot=1 (joined client's player 1). 0 bots -- two humans oppose each other. Sister to listen_host_peer_smoke (kept untouched as the join-handshake regression).

input_sequence.comment: Both processes share this schedule. The host arms --listen-bind and fires netStartServer on the first mainTick where g_NetInit is true (-> 'NET: created server on port 27200', the runner's barrier), seeds g_MatchConfig from --launch-mp-room, and arms --host-autostart. The client arms --connect-host and connects after the barrier. Once the client reaches CLSTATE_LOBBY on the host (slot 1) and a ~2s settle elapses, --host-autostart fires netLobbyRequestStartWithSims exactly once; the ready gate runs a 3s countdown (client answers manifest READY), then SVC_STAGE_START loads the arena on both sides. The match ends at the forced 35s time limit.

Scripted clean exit at 200s. Budget: clean shared install (typed-archive validate/extract) can take tens of seconds before --listen-bind fires, then boot + connect + ~2s settle + 3s countdown + base:arena_mp_felicity stage load on both processes + ~35s match + endscreen. 200s leaves generous slack so the milestones land before the scripted exit; timeout_seconds=240 backstops it. The client emits SMOKE: result=scripted_exit; the host may be reaped by the runner watchdog after an active loopback session (same as the peer smoke) -- so the scripted-exit count is min:1 (client), not 2.

required_lines: NET: connected to server, sending CLC_AUTH
NET: client slot \d+ assigned to peer
forbidden_patterns: NET: could not init ENet, disabling networking
NET: could not create ENet host on port \d+

required_counts.pattern: NET: connected to server, sending CLC_AUTH
